use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

let width = 10
let height = 12
let random = Random(6)

use Cell = (row: int, column: int)
use Piece = (name: char, size: int, cells: List[Cell])

shape(name: char, size: int, rows: string[]) -> Piece =>
    (
        name = name,
        size = size,
        cells =
            (0..size * size)
                |> filter(i => rows[i / size][i % size] == '#')
                |> map(i => (row = i / size, column = i % size))
                |> collect_list()
    )

let pieces = [
    shape('I', 4, ["....", "####", "....", "...."]),
    shape('O', 2, ["##", "##"]),
    shape('T', 3, [".#.", "###", "..."]),
    shape('S', 3, [".##", "##.", "..."]),
    shape('Z', 3, ["##.", ".##", "..."]),
    shape('J', 3, ["#..", "###", "..."]),
    shape('L', 3, ["..#", "###", "..."])
]

rotated(piece: Piece) -> Piece => (
    name = piece.name,
    size = piece.size,
    cells =
        piece.cells
            |> map(c => (row = c.column, column = piece.size - 1 - c.row))
            |> collect_list()
)

let well = LIST[char]((0..width * height) |> map(_ => '.'))

let bag = LIST[Piece]()

draw() -> Piece is
    if bag.count == 0 then
        bag.add_range(
            pieces
                |> map(p => (piece = p, key = random.next()))
                |> sort((a, b) => a.key <> b.key)
                |> map(p => p.piece))
    fi

    let next = bag[0]
    bag.remove_at(0)
    next
si

free(r: int, k: int) -> bool =>
    r >= 0 /\ r < height /\ k >= 0 /\ k < width /\
    well[r * width + k] == '.'

fits(piece: Piece, row: int, column: int) -> bool =>
    piece.cells |> all(c => free(row + c.row, column + c.column))

squares(piece: Piece, row: int, column: int) -> Pipe[int] =>
    piece.cells |> map(c => (row + c.row) * width + column + c.column)

let current mut = draw()
let next mut = draw()
let row mut = 0
let column mut = 3
let score mut = 0

show() is
    let occupied = SET[int](squares(current, row, column))
    let preview = SET[int](squares(next, 0, 0))

    let symbol = (i: int) =>
        if occupied.contains(i) then current.name else well[i] fi

    let upcoming = (r: int) =>
        (0..4)
            |> map(k =>
                let i = r * width + k in
                if preview.contains(i) then next.name else ' ' fi)
            |> join("")

    for r in 0..height do
        let line =
            (0..width) |> map(k => symbol(r * width + k)) |> join("")

        let side =
            if r == 0 then "  next"
            elif r >= 1 /\ r <= 2 then "  {upcoming(r - 1)}"
            elif r == 4 then "  score {score}"
            else ""
            fi

        write_line("|{line}|{side}")
    od

    write_line("+{"".pad_right(width, '-')}+")
si

lock() -> bool is
    for i in squares(current, row, column) do
        well[i] = current.name
    od

    let full =
        (0..height)
            |> filter(r => (0..width) |> all(k => !free(r, k)))
            |> collect_list()

    for r in full do
        well.remove_range(r * width, width)
        well.insert_range(0, (0..width) |> map(_ => '.'))
    od

    score = score + [0, 100, 300, 500, 800][full.count]

    current = next
    next = draw()
    row = 0
    column = 3

    fits(current, row, column)
si

write_line("keys: a left, d right, w rotate, s soft drop, x hard drop")
show()

let playing mut = true

while playing do
    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        break
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")

    for key in line do
        case key
        when 'a' then
            if fits(current, row, column - 1) then column = column - 1 fi
        when 'd' then
            if fits(current, row, column + 1) then column = column + 1 fi
        when 'w' then
            let turned = rotated(current)
            if fits(turned, row, column) then current = turned fi
        when 's' then
            if fits(current, row + 1, column) then
                row = row + 1
            else
                playing = lock()
            fi
        when 'x' then
            while fits(current, row + 1, column) do
                row = row + 1
            od

            playing = lock()
        else
        esac

        if !playing then
            break
        fi
    od

    show()
od

if !playing then
    write_line("the well is full: game over with score {score}")
fi
